source_contract.domain_selection: select source_nodes whose frozen domain identity is Domain IV, preserving exact source order and identity

batching.rule: No frozen source node may be omitted, duplicated, renamed, reordered, or migrated. Candidate topology remains Learning-owner provisional unless stronger source or human authority is separately observed.

candidate_requirements.subskills: Each candidate requirement receives one bounded assessable capability statement, exact frozen parent binding, Learning-owner provisional derivation class, evidence references and matching decomposition edge.
candidate_requirements.prerequisite_edges: Do not infer hard dependencies from source order or topic proximity. Admit a hard edge only with explicit evidence-bound semantic rationale accepted by the existing topology contract; otherwise preserve it as UNRESOLVED__NOT_CANONICAL.
candidate_requirements.acyclicity: Every cumulative candidate must remain acyclic and endpoint-resolvable under Validator 003.

successor_instruction: Materialize the exact first five frozen Domain IV source-order requirements IV.A.1, IV.A.2, IV.B.1, IV.B.2 and IV.C.1; add only evidence-bound provisional subskills/decomposition and justified prerequisites; preserve uncertain dependencies as UNRESOLVED__NOT_CANONICAL; validate cumulatively against completed Domains I-III using unchanged Validator 003; preserve exact hosted evidence; then continue Domain IV batch 02 rather than stopping.
stop_condition: All six frozen Domain IV requirements have truthful source-order bounded dispositions across two validated batches, all admitted edges remain resolvable and acyclic, uncertainty remains explicit, human/SME/certification fields remain UNOBSERVED, and the next Domain V successor can be selected without replaying Domains I-IV.
